mechanism: Amphetamine increases CNS stimulation and seizure threshold lowering, while lacosamide is an antiepileptic; combined use may reduce lacosamide efficacy and increase seizure risk, plus additive cardiac effects.
action: Monitor seizure control closely; consider alternative stimulant or adjust lacosamide dosing; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended due to lacosamide's cardiac conduction effects and amphetamine's sympathomimetic activity.
